title: TRUNK-6731: Add paging support to the obs retrieval API
body:
<!--- Add a pull request title above in this format -->
<!--- real example: 'TRUNK-5111: Replace use of deprecated isVoided' -->
<!--- 'TRUNK-JiraIssueNumber: JiraIssueTitle' -->
## Description of what I changed
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
<!--- It can simply be your commit message, which you must have -->
I added paging support to the obs retrieval API by introducing a new getObservations overload that accepts Integer startIndex and Integer maxResults in ObsDAO, ObsService, HibernateObsDAO, and ObsServiceImpl. The existing overloads now delegate to the new paged variant with null, null, maintaining backward compatibility. Paging is applied at the SQL level using JPA setFirstResult/setMaxResults (LIMIT/OFFSET) rather than in memory, and mostRecentN takes precedence over the paging parameters when both are provided. Also added four tests covering page boundaries, a start index beyond the available results, interaction with mostRecentN, and backward compatibility with null paging parameters.
